Alive Wellness Retreats was
Founded In Noosa, Qld In 2009 As A Sanctuary For Healing

Escape the pressures of daily life with a luxury wellness retreat designed for Australians seeking rest, clarity, health, de stress and full life renewal. Whether you are drawn to a holistic wellness retreat, stress and burnout recovery retreat, detox and health reset, weight loss and fitness retreat, or a complete 360° lifestyle transformation, Alive Luxury Retreats offers deeply personalised programs designed to restore balance on every level.

Alive Luxury Wellness Retreats opened in Noosa, QLD Australia in 2009 as one of the world’s first holistic retreats, setting a new global benchmark long before wellness retreats became mainstream. In 2013, Alive expanded internationally, opening its now flagship retreat centre in Bali and now Mexico, where it continues to deliver world-leading wellness and mental health retreats today grounded in experience, integrity, and proven results.

At Alive Luxury Retreats still Australian run and owned, we offer transformational holistic retreats guided by the Alive Process®, our proven model integrating mind, body, heart, and soul transformation for long-term change in all life areas.

Imagine spending your days in a luxury private suite or pool villa, practicing sunrise yoga and meditation, receiving powerful holistic 1:1 therapies, and being supported by a world-class team who truly understands transformation. Your retreat may include holistic counselling, somatic healing, breathwork, coaching, massage, yoga, meditation, fitness, adventure, and nourishing detox cuisine — all carefully designed to help you feel grounded, clear, energised, and deeply connected to yourself again.
This is more than a retreat. It’s a return to who you are meant to be supported by a team who has been guiding life-changing wellness and mental health transformations for Australians since 2009.
